exec git init -b main
at 2026-08-10T16:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix root- --board-name 'Root board'
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential
exec card project create Secondary --prefix secondary-

# An explicit project bypasses ambient board selection, including for a
# project that has no boards.
env CARDAMOM_BOARD=missing-board
exec card --json config show --project Secondary
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/effective.json
exec card --json config show --project project_11111111111111111111 --scope project
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/layer.json

# Direct project mutation returns a project-scoped view and persists the
# override without routing through a board.
exec card --json config set --project Secondary --scope project issue.id.strategy random
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/overridden.json
exec card --json config show --project project_11111111111111111111 --scope project
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/overridden-layer.json
exec card --json config unset --project project_11111111111111111111 --scope project issue.id.strategy
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/effective.json
exec card config show --project project_11111111111111111111
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/effective.txt

# An explicit board and a direct project are competing targets. Direct project
# mutation accepts only the project scope.
! exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 config show --project project_11111111111111111111
! stdout .
stderr '--project cannot be combined with --board'
! exec card config set --project project_11111111111111111111 --scope board issue.id.strategy random
! stdout .
stderr '--scope "board" cannot be used with --project'

# Duplicate exact names preserve project selector ambiguity.
exec card project create Secondary --prefix duplicate-
! exec card config show --project Secondary
! stdout .
stderr 'project "Secondary" is ambiguous; use an ID'
